title: WU JEN THIRD LEVEL SPELLS - the 24 third level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R672 OA wu jen third level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round fifty-nine (capture pp. 173-181): the wu jen third level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: WU JEN THIRD LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 173-181 - the OA wu jen third level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 173-181; compressed pp. 82-85); all 24 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads - the variances typographic or prose-only (the compressed Scy for scry in the header, the print 6-10 against the compressed 8-10 for the cloudburst large-fire quench, the feign death duration sign, the fire rain 1d8 read as 108 in the compressed - none of them grid cells). The level is alteration-heavy again: seven of the 24 spells, enchantment/charm and illusion four each, divination three, evocation and abjuration two each, conjuration and necromantic one each (animate fire the lone conjuration, feign death the lone necromantic). TWO dual-school prints pin the primary (the exaction precedent): fabricate the Enchantment/Alteration dual pinned 1, face the Illusion/Phantasm; Enchantment/Charm dual pinned 9. The component census: 19 VSM, dispel magic and feign death the verbal and somatic pair, suggestion and tongues the V,M pairs, hold person the lone verbal-only. THREE spells take the Casting Time: Special line (fabricate, illusionary script, memory) pinned -1, the R662 exorcise variable-cast convention; four one-turn casts (commune with lesser spirit, disguise, face, scry), five one-round, seven three-segment, cloudburst and fire rain five segments, statue the lone seven-segment cast, feign death the lone single segment. Four negation saves, four special, fire rain and steam breath the two half saves (the damage halved). Four spells read Reversible (face, magnetism, memory, tongues). The sixth column cross-checks the R669 element grid: the seven tagged cells matching the landed dieWJT66L3Element pins exactly - animate fire Fire, cloudburst the Water/Air dual code 8, magnetism and statue Earth, steam breath Air, scry All, wood shape Nature. The stat grid pins as a table: 24 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60, -1 the special cast), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and element markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag WJL3Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
